author: IzzyM_
body:
IzzyM_
I was temp banned for "Auto-Sprint" and "Kill Aura"
I should be unbanned from the server because, it was not auto sprint nor was in kill aura. I was simply holding down my sprint button while jittering. (Which is not against the rules). I was banned more than a year ago, but i had joined 2 years ago. Though i was not hacking, i beleive i am well in the time line for an unban.
